entities.name: Thomil
entities.description: A human planeswalker, one of the first named in Magic's story, and Worzel's rival; he uses shadow, smoke and darkness magic.

entities.name: Worzel
entities.description: A planeswalker who often duelled Thomil, including on Ergamon, where she held a domain.

entities.name: Ergamon
entities.description: A plane where Thomil invaded Worzel's domain and fought her.

entities.name: Sauruven Hellwald
entities.description: A black knight whose master was Thomil.

entities.name: Lord of the Pit
entities.description: A demon Thomil summoned against Worzel and then lost control of.

events.summary: Thomil invaded Worzel's domain on Ergamon and fought her with black mana, Zombies and a Lord of the Pit, overpowering her red, blue and green magic.
events.quote: he invaded Worzel's domain and fought her using black mana with Zombies and a Lord of the Pit

events.summary: Thomil lost control of the demon after Worzel resisted it with a Circle of Protection: Black, and fled the plane, ending the duel.
events.quote: he lost control of the demon after Worzel resisted its attacks with a Circle of Protection: Black

relations.quote: He was Worzel 's rival and a human .
He was the black knight Sauruven Hellwald 's master.
